description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the ConceptValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It verifies the validation logic applied to Concept objects, including checking for duplicate names, required fields, proper localization, and concept mappings.

classes.name: ConceptValidator
classes.description: The ConceptValidator class performs validation checks on Concept objects to ensure data integrity before persistence.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a Concept object, checking for required fields, duplicate names, proper localization, and concept mappings.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheObjectParameterIsNull
methods.description: Test case that verifies validation fails when the Concept object is null.

methods.name: shouldFailIfNamesAreEmpty
methods.description: Test case that verifies validation fails when the Concept has no names.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheConceptDatatypeIsNull
methods.description: Test case that verifies validation fails if the concept's datatype is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheConceptClassIsNull
methods.description: Test case that verifies validation fails if the concept's class is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyNameIsAnEmptyString
methods.description: Test case that verifies validation fails if any of the Concept's names are empty strings.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyNameIsANullValue
methods.description: Test case that verifies validation fails if any of the Concept's names are null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsADuplicateUnretiredConceptNameInTheLocale
methods.description: Test case that verifies validation fails if there's a duplicate, unretired ConceptName in the same locale.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyNamesInTheSameLocaleForThisConceptAreSimilar
methods.description: Test case that checks for duplicate names within the same Concept in the same locale.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsADuplicateUnretiredFullySpecifiedNameInTheSameLocale
methods.description: Test case for duplicates of fully specified names in the same locale.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsADuplicateUnretiredPreferredNameInTheSameLocale
methods.description: Tests for duplicate preferred names in the same locale.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsNoNameExplicitlyMarkedAsFullySpecified
methods.description: Verifies that validation fails if no fully specified name is set on the Concept.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptIsBeingUpdatedWithNoNameChange
methods.description: Test ensuring validation passes if the concept has no name changes during an update.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptHasAtleastOneFullySpecifiedNameAddedToIt
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if at least one fully specified name exists.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheDuplicateConceptNameIsNeitherPreferredNorFullySpecified
methods.description: Test for accepting duplicate names if they are not preferred or fully specified.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptWithADuplicateNameIsRetired
methods.description: Checks that retired concepts with duplicate names pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptBeingValidatedIsRetiredAndHasADuplicateName
methods.description: Tests that a retired Concept with duplicate name passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptHasASynonymThatIsAlsoAShortName
methods.description: Verifies that a Concept with a synonym that is also a short name does not fail validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfATermIsMappedMultipleTimesToTheSameConcept
methods.description: Tests that multiple identical concept mappings are flagged as errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheDuplicateNameInTheLocaleForTheConceptBeingValidatedIsVoided
methods.description: Validates that voided duplicate names in the same locale do not trigger errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsADuplicateUnretiredConceptNameInTheSameLocaleDifferentThanTheSystemLocale
methods.description: Checks detection of duplicate concept names in a different system locale.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForANewConceptWithAMapCreatedWithDeprecatedConceptMapMethods
methods.description: Verifies validation passes for new concepts with concept mappings created via deprecated methods.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForAnEditedConceptWithAMapCreatedWithDeprecatedConceptMapMethods
methods.description: Verifies validation passes for edited concepts with concept mappings created via deprecated methods.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailIfATermHasTwoNewMappingsOnIt
methods.description: Ensures no errors if a concept has multiple new concept mappings.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that field length constraints are respected.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation errors when field length constraints are violated.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfFullySpecifiedNameIsTheSameAsShortName
methods.description: Verifies that identical fully specified and short names are accepted.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfDifferentConceptsHaveTheSameShortNames
methods.description: Tests that different concepts can have the same short name.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfCodedConceptContainsItselfAsAnAnswer
methods.description: Ensures that a concept cannot list itself as an answer.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailIfAnyDescriptionIsNotEnteredWhileCreatingANewConcept
methods.description: Checks that missing descriptions do not cause validation failure in new concepts.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfNoneofTheConceptDescriptionsIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that the presence of descriptions (even if empty) does not cause errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailIfBlankConceptDescriptionIsPassed
methods.description: Allows blank descriptions without validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldSkipConceptNameValidationForRetiredConcepts
methods.description: Validates that retired concepts skip name validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldSkipConceptMapValidationForRetiredConcepts
methods.description: Validates that retired concepts skip concept map validation.
